blocks.title: Excalidraw in the activity panel
blocks.description: Hand-drawn flowcharts, sketches and diagrams — the official Excalidraw editor running inside Astravia, with the drawing you opened in the workspace.

showcase.user_prompt: Turn this sketch into a flowchart.
showcase.assistant_reply: Six boxes connected. Saved to the workspace.

items.title: The editor itself
items.description: The tab runs the web build Excalidraw publishes from its own source: the same canvas, toolbars, menus and export dialogs, not an imitation of them.

items.title: Saves into your project
items.description: A drawing arrives as a .excalidraw file through Astravia rather than a downloads folder, and opening one uses the file selected in the Explorer.

items.title: Export without leaving the tab
items.description: PNG, SVG and .excalidraw export run inside the editor; the file comes back through the same bridge as a save.

items.title: Driven from the conversation
items.description: Ask in chat and the panel carries it out: pointer and keyboard steps arrive in the canvas one after another, each named while it happens.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: The site ships inside the plugin, so the first open needs no download and later opens work offline.

items.title: Open the Excalidraw tab
items.description: The panel shows the whiteboard straight away — no preparation screen.

items.title: Draw, or ask for a change
items.description: Use the toolbar as usual, or describe the diagram you want and let the agent place the boxes.

items.title: Save back to the workspace
items.description: Menu → Save returns the .excalidraw file to the workspace, where the next session can open it again.

blocks.content: The editor is Excalidraw's own build, produced at publish time from a pinned commit of the upstream repository (MIT). The plugin adds the panel around it and adjusts the page's asset paths so it can run from inside the package; the drawing engine, fonts and interface are unmodified.
Interface language: Excalidraw ships dozens of translations and the tab follows your Astravia language, so a Chinese interface stays Chinese here.

Collaboration links, cloud library sync and Excalidraw+ are upstream features that need their own network service; they are not configured by this plugin, and a drawing stays local unless you export it.
